descriptionFull: The common nightingale or simply nightingale ( Luscinia megarhynchos ), also known as rufous nightingale , is a small passerine bird best known for its powerful and beautiful song. It was formerly classed as a member of the thrush family Turdidae, but is now more generally considered to be an Old World flycatcher, Muscicapidae. It belongs to a group of more terrestrial species, often called chats.
